summary: Section 48 — Google Cloud APIs hardening: 10/10 backend pytest pass + 12/12 frontend UI checks pass. /api/admin/google-cloud-status auth gating (200/403/401) + shape contract verified. /api/translate and /api/card-scan return source='api_error' + error_kind='permission_denied' + Spanish note when key invalid (matches reality of current revoked GOOGLE_API_KEY). Admin Ops Cloud tab renders INACTIVA badges, Spanish hints, console.cloud.google.com links + 4-step tutorial; Refrescar triggers network. Provider dashboard surfaces 'Escanear tarjeta de negocio' button that opens BusinessCardScanner modal. Public eCard renders TranslatableDescription with toggle — click degrades gracefully (note shown, description text preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: _diagnose_google_api_error covers all 5 documented Google failure modes (api_disabled/permission_denied/quota_exceeded/bad_request/unknown) + a network fallback at the call site — good coverage.
/api/admin/google-cloud-status fires two parallel httpx probes (asyncio.gather) so admin UX stays snappy (~1.8s observed) — well done.

Reality probe: current GOOGLE_API_KEY (AIzaSy…) returns HTTP 403 + 'API key not valid' which the diagnoser correctly maps to error_kind='permission_denied' (matches main agent's note). When CEO replaces / unrestricts the key, the same probe should flip to enabled:true with zero code changes.

Pre-existing (NOT introduced this iter): React hydration warning <span> inside <option> in ProviderDashboard.jsx US_STATES select — already flagged in iteration_47.json, still present. Low priority cleanup.
/api/translate and /api/card-scan correctly preserve the original text/payload on api_error so the UI never shows an empty description — graceful degradation contract is solid.
Public eCard TranslatableDescription correctly renders the note (data-testid='translatable-description-note') AND keeps the source text visible on error — confirmed in screenshot.
seed_data_creation: None — tests are read-only diagnostics. Translation cache entry created for 'Hola, soy María.' es→en under source_id=TEST_iter48 (1 row, expires automatically in 90d via TTL index).
context_for_next_testing_agent: When CEO enables Translation + Vision APIs in Google Cloud Console (or rotates GOOGLE_API_KEY to a valid one), re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter48_google_cloud_status.py — the same suite covers both states (enabled and disabled). The TestRealityProbe test accepts both happy-path and known-failure error_kinds so it remains stable across the toggle. Frontend Cloud tab will flip INACTIVA badges → ACTIVA automatically once /api/admin/google-cloud-status returns enabled:true.
verified_endpoints: POST /api/card-scan (api_error + error_kind=permission_denied + Spanish note + empty fields)
